svg.text: Terrain toolbar — Buildings: remove · make enterable · add door (CE-5024 / CE-5025)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app. ⭐ new · everything else on the toolbar is unchanged (DESIGN_Terrain_Editor_UX §6, as built).
flat ground, its doors and damage go
click a wall of a doorless house
an armed tool, then a click on a BAKED building (one that came with the terrain);
the cursor highlights the one it would act on; Esc disarms (UX_Feature_Tool_Model, unchanged)
SOLID — no interior · 1 storey · 22 m² · shed
⭐ the SAME generator as the importer (BuildingTemplateGenerator): floors, a stair
per storey pair, windows as wall openings, and ≥ 1 door on the wall facing the
nearest road — the rule the importer then also guarantees (D-6)
the ground under it is LEVELLED to its floor height (a skirt blends it back);
its doors and its damage are gone with it; closing the toolbar hides the ghost;
Restore = delete the edit (one undo step either way)
an edit is an ordinary scenario terrain feature (kind Edit): listed, selectable, undoable, saved with the
scenario; 'Save terrain as' bakes it into the terrain (the building leaves world.json for good)
click a free wall to put a door there
(a wall it shares with a neighbour is refused)
a door is placed where the wall is free; the house is regenerated by the
same generator with that door hint (its windows placed again by the same rule)
